name: Umezawa Soichiro
source: A third-year student who is always in the student council room (for no good reason, since he’s not actually a member). Likes to lecture others even though he never does anything useful himself. Even though he is always cheerful, his inability to read the room keeps him from being likable. A bit narcissistic and a bit pretentious, but somehow you just can’t hate him for it.
